:::{.phase-header}
# From Vibes to Variables
**3rd Edition, Fall 2026**

A complete open textbook for research methods in mass communication. 14 chapters across 5 parts, designed for both undergraduate (MC 451) and graduate (MC 501) instruction.

[Read the Full Textbook](https://aura-lab-siue.github.io/v2v/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
:::

---

:::{.callout-note}
## Preview Edition

This page previews the chapter structure and themes for the Fall 2026 edition. The full textbook is available online and is updated regularly.
:::

---

## Part I: Foundation

*Chapters 1 to 3 build the habits and infrastructure every researcher needs before touching data.*

| Ch | Title | What You'll Learn |
|----|-------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Science of Storytelling** | How research questions emerge from curiosity, and why storytelling and science share a method |
| 2 | **The Open Workspace** | Setting up VS Code, R, Git, and the course workspace as one reproducible environment |
| 3 | **Knowing and Knowing Well** | Epistemology for researchers: what counts as evidence, and how we know what we know |

---

## Part II: Planning

*Chapters 4 to 6 cover the decisions that shape a study before any data is collected.*

| Ch | Title | What You'll Learn |
|----|-------|-------------------|
| 4 | **Intelligence Gathering** | Reading the literature actively and turning it into a strategic map |
| 5 | **Theory as a Lens** | How theoretical frameworks focus your questions and interpretation |
| 6 | **The Prospectus** | Crafting a precise, testable research plan that drives the study forward |

---

## Part III: Operationalization

*Chapters 7 to 9 turn concepts into measurable variables and a working codebook.*

| Ch | Title | What You'll Learn |
|----|-------|-------------------|
| 7 | **Structured Listening** | Qualitative immersion in the Twitch corpus: observing, and pattern-finding |
| 8 | **From Vibes to Variables** | Building a quantitative codebook from qualitative observations |
| 9 | **The Rulebook and First Workspace** | Decision rules, anchor examples, and intercoder reliability |

---

## Part IV: Execution

*Chapters 10 to 12 walk from a sampling plan through cleaned data to visualization.*

| Ch | Title | What You'll Learn |
|----|-------|-------------------|
| 10 | **The Sample** | Sample size, selection strategy, and pilot testing your codebook |
| 11 | **Wrangling the Data** | Data cleaning in R: import, diagnose, fix, and export |
| 12 | **Visualizing the Narrative** | Descriptive statistics, frequency tables, and publication-quality visualization |

---

## Part V: Inference and Publication

*Chapters 13 to 14 test relationships and turn findings into a professional research product.*

| Ch | Title | What You'll Learn |
|----|-------|-------------------|
| 13 | **Making the Call** | Inferential statistics: chi-square, correlation, effect sizes, and APA reporting |
| 14 | **The One-Click Report** | Assembling the White Paper as a Quarto book (PDF plus website) and publishing to GitHub Pages |

---

## About the Textbook

*From Vibes to Variables* is an open educational resource written by Dr. Alex P. Leith for research methods courses at SIUE. The 3rd edition (Fall 2026) presents the material in 14 focused chapters, adds the R Workbook as a companion, and integrates with the [course workspace](workspace.qmd) and the [v2v R package](https://github.com/AURA-Lab-SIUE/v2v-r).

The textbook is free, open-access, and published via [GitHub Pages](https://aura-lab-siue.github.io/v2v/).
